plan.description: Data Reading and Initialization: Read the single-cell RNA-seq dataset using Scanpy. This step involves loading the .h5ad file to create an AnnData object that contains the raw gene expression matrix and associated metadata. This forms the basis for all downstream analyses.
input_filename: ./data/cell_annotation/dataset_debug_restricted.h5ad: A single-cell RNA-seq dataset containing gene expression profiles with cell barcodes and gene names.
output_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct3/initialized_data.h5ad: AnnData object after data reading and initialization

plan.description: Quality Control (QC): Perform QC on the dataset to filter out low-quality cells based on metrics such as mitochondrial gene percentage, total UMIs, and the number of detected genes. This step cleans the dataset to retain high-quality cells for accurate clustering and downstream analysis.
input_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct3/initialized_data.h5ad: AnnData object after data reading and initialization
output_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct3/qc_filtered_data.h5ad: AnnData object after quality control filtering

plan.description: Normalization and Highly Variable Gene Selection: Normalize the QC-filtered data using total count normalization and log transformation. Then, identify highly variable genes (HVGs) in the dataset. This step standardizes the expression values across cells and selects genes that contribute most to the variance, thereby improving clustering performance.
input_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct3/qc_filtered_data.h5ad: AnnData object after quality control filtering
output_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct3/normalized_hvg_data.h5ad: AnnData object with normalized expression values and highly variable genes

plan.description: Dimensionality Reduction and Clustering Analysis: Perform Principal Component Analysis (PCA) for dimensionality reduction followed by neighborhood graph construction. Cluster the cells using the Leiden algorithm and compute UMAP for visualization. This step separates the cells into clusters based on their gene expression profiles and prepares the dataset for marker gene identification.
input_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct3/normalized_hvg_data.h5ad: AnnData object with normalized expression values and highly variable genes
output_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct3/clustering_results.h5ad: AnnData object with dimension reduction and clustering annotations

plan.description: Differential Expression and Marker Gene Identification: For each identified cluster, perform differential expression analysis using tools available in Scanpy (e.g., tl.rank_genes_groups) to identify marker genes. Utilize known malignant cell markers to evaluate and classify clusters as malignant or non-malignant based on the expression of these marker genes.
input_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct3/clustering_results.h5ad: AnnData object with dimension reduction and clustering annotations
output_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct3/marker_gene_results.h5ad: AnnData object updated with differential expression results and marker gene profiles per cluster

plan.description: Cell Classification and Output Generation: Classify cells as malignant or non-malignant by integrating the cluster marker gene profiles and leveraging known malignant markers. Annotate the AnnData object with the cell classification information and save the final annotated dataset to an output .h5ad file. This file will contain comprehensive cell annotations including the malignant classification.
input_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct3/marker_gene_results.h5ad: AnnData object updated with marker gene profiles
output_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct3/classified_cells.h5ad: Final annotated AnnData object with malignant classification of cells
